doc: A kiln, and the log of what was fired in it.

record.name: cone
record.doc: How hot: the pyrometric cone, 1 to 10.

variant.name: too-hot
variant.doc: The kiln goes to cone 10; this asked for more.

types.name: reading
types.doc: The kiln's temperature at one moment of a firing.

methods.name: fire
methods.doc:
Fire the kiln and write it in the log. It waits out the whole
firing, reading by reading; other calls run meanwhile.

methods.name: heat
methods.doc:
A firing as it happens: a reading every five minutes, climbing
to the cone's temperature, holding there, then cooling. The
next reading is not worked out until the last one is taken.

methods.name: hottest
methods.doc: The hottest firing so far, if there was one.
